svg.title: Payment Component Database Schema - Smart-Contract Pattern (Contract-First Architecture with Normalized Master-Detail Pattern) (Component Tables with FK References - NO Core Table Extensions)

g.text: Payment Component Database Schema - Smart-Contract Pattern
(Component Tables with FK References - NO Core Table Extensions)
- No NULL columns for type-specific data
Every auth transaction needs these fields
- Tracking code sent to provider API
- No JSON blob in master table
Add provider fields without schema changes
1. Most transactions don't need all fields
Architecture Principle: Normalized Master-Detail + Smart Contracts
